action.message:
Done. I edited only `django/db/models/sql/query.py`:

1. Added a `contains_over_clause` property to the `Query` class (after `has_limit_one`), which returns True when any selected expression, annotation, or WHERE child contains a window (OVER) clause.
2. `Query.get_aggregation` already consults `self.contains_over_clause` when deciding whether to wrap the inner query in a subquery; with the property now defined, aggregates that reference window-function annotations are pushed into an inner subquery and aggregated in the outer query, avoiding the "aggregate function calls cannot contain window function calls" / "misuse of window function" errors.
